invariants.rationale: Parallelism is typically expected to be positive in parallel processing context.
data is used immediately; a null value would cause a NullPointerException.
func is required for mapping; a null value would result in runtime exceptions.
If data is empty, parallelism value becomes irrelevant; often in practice, single-threaded execution is used for empty datasets.
parallelism is often capped to the number of processors for efficiency.
